# Conair Quick Twist Bonus Pack: Twisty Braid Styler with Accessories

Refresh your hairstyles at home with the Conair Quick Twist Bonus Pack. This twisty braid styler helps you create colorful, trendy looks in seconds, so you can try new styles whenever you like.

## Key Features

The Quick Twist styler works in three simple steps: raise the clasp, insert a hair strand, and rotate the styler to form a twisted braid. The bonus pack includes 40 Scünci anti-slip mini elastics, two silky ribbons, 10 hair clips, a strand of pearls, a sequin ribbon, a detangling brush, a section and style comb, headbands, and ponytailers.

## Benefits for Your Routine

- **Save time:** Create twisted styles in seconds instead of spending long sessions braiding by hand.
- **Personalize every look:** Combine ribbons, pearls, and elastics to design one-of-a-kind styles.
- **Learn quickly:** Straightforward steps make it easy for beginners to get started.
- **Get creative beyond hair:** Knitters and crocheters can use it to twist yarn ends into fringe.

## Good to Know

Requires 2 AA batteries (not included). Contains small parts and is recommended for children 6 years and older.

## Get Your Twist On

Ready to try a new look? Add the Conair Quick Twist Bonus Pack to your cart today and start creating your next twisty style at home.
